advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Fix the inconsistent count in the TicketTransport docstring: 'Twelve of the twenty-one were undeclared' mixes the 12-omitted (of eighteen) figure with the twenty-one denominator (21-6=15).
evidence: src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/_backend.py:191-197: '... the core reaches for TWENTY-ONE distinct transport members; the eighteen below are the always-required subset ... Twelve of the twenty-one were undeclared; the twelve it omitted were therefore unchecked ... a transport missing all twelve passed isinstance'
Inline comment anchoring the '12' to the required set, not to 21: src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/_backend.py:225 '# -- the twelve the core also reaches for (J9)'
Arithmetic: original declaration was six members ('It declared six members'); 18-6=12 (the omitted required members), but 21-6=15, so 'twelve of the twenty-one' does not reconcile.
advisory.finding: The revised docstring says 'Twelve of the twenty-one were undeclared,' but the '12' figure is the count of members omitted from the original SIX-member declaration within the EIGHTEEN-member required set (18-6=12). Measured against the new 'twenty-one' denominator the sentence introduces, 21-6=15 were undeclared, not 12 — the numerator was kept while the denominator changed, making the count self-contradictory with the immediately following 'the twelve it omitted ... missing all twelve' which is only coherent against the eighteen frame.
advisory.suggested_fix: Anchor the twelve to the eighteen-member required set, e.g. 'Twelve of the eighteen always-required members were undeclared; the twelve it omitted were therefore unchecked ...' — keeping the twenty-one total as the separate 18+4 framing.
